text: 沃伦先生走到第一张桌旁，掀开盖布，露出一对奇怪的陶土圆筒，上面刻满诡异纹路。它们体积不大，看起来相当脆弱，侧面有几道很深的裂缝。
沃伦先生走到下一张桌旁，也揭开了上面的物品。这件东西大得多，也更加华丽，看起来像某种祭坛或圣物匣，上面镶满黄绿色宝石。不过它和第一件物品有一处相似：上面也出现了那些奇怪的文字，只是这些文字似乎是画上去的。
这位老学者转向下一件物品，将它展示给所有人看：一顶装饰华丽的纯青铜王冠，上面铸有一位印度教神祇的形象。
下一件物品肯定最为寻常：一本厚实的大型日记本，包着皮革封面，显然用旧了、饱经磨损，页间还夹着几张散页。沃伦先生注意到人群中有人困惑，便解释说，这本笔记收集了哈里斯教授的个人作品和研究。
日记本之后展示的是一件保存完好的婆罗门祭司仪式长袍，布料纯白。
最后一件物品或许最为奇怪。那是一尊小雕像或偶像，想必是古印度众多神祇之一。它由蓝绿色石头雕成蜥蜴般的怪物，造型相当丑恶；做工粗糙而花哨，看起来像是假的。人们开始在物品间走动，仔细查看并低声交谈。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 70
text: Mr. Warren approaches the first table and removes the cloth covering to reveal an odd pair of clay cylinders covered with strange etchings. They are small and seem quite fragile, with large cracks running down their sides.

Mr. Warren proceeds to the next table and likewise uncovers the item in question. This one is significantly larger and more ornate. It appears to be some sort of altar or reliquary, heavily decorated with yellow-green gemstones. However, there is one similarity with the first item: the presence of the same strange written characters, though these ones seem to have been painted on.
The old scholar turns to the next item in question and displays it for all to see: a decorated crown of solid bronze, wrought with the image of a Hindu god.

The next item is certainly the most mundane: a large, thick, leather-bound journal that appears well-worn and beaten, with several loose papers jammed between the pages. Mr. Warren senses the confusion of some members of the crowd and clarifies that the notebook is the assembled personal works and studies of Prof. Harris.
The item that follows the journal is a well-preserved ceremonial robe of a Brahmin priest. The cloth is pure white.

The last item is perhaps the strangest of all. It is a small statue or idol, presumably of one of the many deities of ancient India. Made from a blue-green stone in the shape of a rather grotesque lizard-like creature, the craftsmanship is crude and gaudy, so much so that it appears fake. People begin moving among the items, looking them over and conversing quietly.
